blocks.raw: # Ads Audience Campaign
blocks.text: Ads Audience Campaign

blocks.raw: The Ads Audience campaign helps you sync your customer audience group in Engage+ with advertising platforms like Meta, Google, and TikTok. This campaign type lets you automatically export and sync audience segments from Engage+ to your chosen advertising platform. The audience data is synced to the Ad platform using a third-party service provider.
blocks.text: The Ads Audience campaign helps you sync your customer audience group in Engage+ with advertising platforms like Meta, Google, and TikTok. blocks.raw: **Key Benefits**
blocks.text: Key Benefits

blocks.raw:

blocks.raw: # Creating an Ads audience campaign to sync the audience data with advertising platforms
blocks.text: Creating an Ads audience campaign to sync the audience data with advertising platforms

blocks.raw: To create an Ads audience campaign and sync the audience data with the advertising platforms, follow these steps:
blocks.text: To create an Ads audience campaign and sync the audience data with the advertising platforms, follow these steps:

blocks.raw:
1. From the **Engage** dashboard, click **create New Campaign**.
2. Enter **Campaign name** and set the **Campaign duration**.
3. Under Campaign Type, select **Ad Audience**.
4. Select **save campaign**.

blocks.raw: ## Segment Name Guidelines for Advertising Sync
blocks.text: Segment Name Guidelines for Advertising Sync

blocks.raw: When running multiple ad campaigns over time, how you manage the **Segment name** affects how audiences are synced with advertising platforms.
blocks.text: When running multiple ad campaigns over time, how you manage the Segment name affects how audiences are synced with advertising platforms.

blocks.raw: **a. Use a new segment name** when your goal is to target a new or updated audience list.
blocks.text: a. Use a new segment name when your goal is to target a new or updated audience list.

blocks.raw: **Why:** This creates a new audience group on the advertising platform, preventing overlap with users already targeted.
blocks.text: Why: This creates a new audience group on the advertising platform, preventing overlap with users already targeted.

blocks.raw:
**Example:**\
  On Day 1, you create a segment named `Inactive_Users_July_Week1` with Audience Group A.
  On Day 5, create a new segment like `Inactive_Users_July_Week2` with Audience Group B that exclude
users already targeted in the first campaign.
blocks.text:
Example:  On Day 1, you create a segment named Inactive_Users_July_Week1 with Audience Group A.
  On Day 5, create a new segment like Inactive_Users_July_Week2 with Audience Group B that exclude
users already targeted in the first campaign.

blocks.raw: **b. Reuse the same segment name** when your goal is to **retarget** the same audience.
blocks.text: b. Reuse the same segment name when your goal is to retarget the same audience.

blocks.raw: **Why:** This avoids duplication of audience groups on the advertising platform or third-party service provider. Reusing the same name ensures the platform updates the existing audience group instead of creating a new one.
blocks.text: Why: This avoids duplication of audience groups on the advertising platform or third-party service provider. Reusing the same name ensures the platform updates the existing audience group instead of creating a new one.

blocks.raw:
**Example:**\
  On Day 1, you create a campaign with segment name `Abandoned_Cart_Users` using Audience Group A.
  On Day 5, to retarget the same users, create a new campaign with Audience Group A and reuse the same
segment name `Abandoned_Cart_Users`.
blocks.text:
Example:  On Day 1, you create a campaign with segment name Abandoned_Cart_Users using Audience Group A.
  On Day 5, to retarget the same users, create a new campaign with Audience Group A and reuse the same
segment name Abandoned_Cart_Users.

blocks.raw: If you use a different segment name with the same audience group, a **new audience group** will be created on the advertising platform, leading to duplication.
blocks.text: If you use a different segment name with the same audience group, a new audience group will be created on the advertising platform, leading to duplication.
